comment: What must not silently disappear from dotfiles. `prose` names guardrails no code enforces; `split` declares which half of the skill is deterministic; `baseline` names the offline, $0 checks pinned against a real run.

prose.pattern: Change only selected managed configuration; preserve unrelated files, local overrides, credentials and application state.
prose.rationale: The one rule. It is the reason this skill exists rather than a prompt; lose the line and the skill becomes a generic assistant with extra steps.

prose.pattern: Never claim a result you did not observe
prose.rationale: Honesty about what was verified is the whole house contract. A skill that reports success it did not witness is worse than one that reports nothing.

prose.pattern: never ask about anything in it
prose.rationale: Inspection answers detectable facts; ask only for missing intent or conflict decisions.

deterministic.step: Discover and validate package layout and link state

nondeterministic.step: Choose configuration edits, package boundaries and local overrides
nondeterministic.why: The user's intent and portability requirements determine what belongs in a shared repository.

nondeterministic.step: Review installer behavior and resolve conflicts
nondeterministic.why: Existing repository code and live application state require contextual review before an authorized change.

_baseline_comment: Pinned against a real run of this skill, never a synthetic fixture. Offline and $0 by construction: no network, no model, so CI cannot spend and cannot flake.

baseline.update_command: node evals/replay.mjs /tmp/dotfiles-reviewed-run && node "$SKILLFACTORY_DIR/scripts/skillfactory.js" freeze --repo "$SKILLS_REPO" --skill dotfiles --from /tmp/dotfiles-reviewed-run --command 'node evals/replay.mjs "$OUT"' --trap-command 'node evals/trap.mjs'
baseline.rationale: Missing files, classification regressions, incorrect state totals and report rendering drift; assert a nonzero file floor. — pinned against A real read-only inspection of the reference dotfiles checkout and its live target; publish only reviewed normalized package/path/state metadata, reconstruct its topology in temporary directories and rerun inspect, verify and report. Never publish file bodies or personal paths.

baseline.rationale: The classifier accepting unsafe filesystem input or report accepting corrupt snapshot data. — pinned against A deliberately unsafe package manifest and a saved inspection with inconsistent counts or an unsafe relative path.
